requires.name: Autonomous Trend-Detection & Rapid-Response Pipeline — product from the library

notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Trend Scanner searches current social platforms for rising formats (view velocity, repost/like ratio as an early-signal proxy) → Brand-Fit Reasoner screens each candidate trend against brand tone/values (discard trends that are off-brand or reputationally risky) → Format Extractor breaks the winning trend into its exact structural beats and documented failure modes → Adaptation Director maps a brand product into those beats → Nano Banana Pro + Omni Flash 1.1 produce the piece → Trend-Fidelity + Brand-Fit dual critic → Repair → Same-day Export → Alert delivered to the marketing team with a recommended posting window while the trend is still rising, not after it peaks.
STAGE 1 — TREND SCANNER No trend is given — the system finds one. The scrape lane stands in for the platform scan: a rising-format query, scraped and randomised each run.
STAGE 2 — BRAND-FIT REASONER + FORMAT EXTRACTOR Screens each candidate against brand tone and risk, then breaks the winner into its exact structural beats and documented failure modes.
STAGE 3 — ADAPTATION DIRECTOR + PRODUCTION The brand product is mapped into the extracted beats and produced.
STAGE 4 — DUAL CRITIC + SAME-DAY EXPORT Trend fidelity and brand fit scored together, then exported for the recommended posting window.
